onSettled replaces committed layout-effect fixtures; native Loading replaces Suspense. React passive-effect ordering, Strict Mode replay and concurrent transition commit semantics require explicit adaptation evidence and are not credited merely from eventual DOM state.

No production, harness, configuration, script, skip, diagnostic budget or tolerance edits. No blanket flush added. Existing synchronous flush in the preexisting function-payload test is retained.
